topics.title: Write about a solution to a definite situation.
guiding_questions: How did you feel about it?
What did you decide to do?
What did you say to the bully?
topics.sample_essay: Last week, I saw some boys making fun of my classmate. I felt very sad for him. I decided to defend him. I said: Stop! Do not hurt him. Be kind to everyone. The boys felt bad and said sorry. My classmate thanked me and smiled. I felt proud of myself. Helping others is great.

topics.title: Write a short biography about a famous person you know.
topics.sample_essay: Messi is a famous football player. He plays for a big team. He is famous for his fast runs and many goals. When he was young, he was sick and had little money. But he never quit. He worked hard every day. His family helped him a lot. Now he is a hero for children.
